name: LedgerRecord
description: One normalized financial object, whether pulled from QuickBooks (invoice, payment, deposit, item...) or imported from outside QuickBooks (sales order, bank deposit, customer deposit, custom type).

record_type.description: Key of the record type, e.g. qbo_invoice, sales_order, bank_deposit, or a custom RecordType key

import_batch_id.description: ImportBatch that created or last updated this record

external_id.description: Id in the source system (QuickBooks Id, CSV reference or row hash). Unique per source + record_type.

version.description: Source version marker (QuickBooks SyncToken) used to skip unchanged rows

name.description: Display name for master data (items, customers, vendors)

balance.description: Open balance, when the source provides it

account.description: Bank or GL account (deposit-to account, bank account on a statement line)

linked.description: Links the source system already knows about, e.g. QuickBooks LinkedTxn: [{ record_type, external_id }]
